rules.title: Messaging Abstraction Layer
rules.check: Messaging MUST use abstractions (IMessageSender, IMessageHandler) not direct broker clients.
rules.rationale: Abstraction enables switching between NATS, Service Bus, RabbitMQ without changing business logic.

rules.title: Message Handler Interface
rules.check: Message handlers MUST implement IMessageHandler<T> for automatic discovery and registration.

rules.title: Dual Messaging Support
rules.check: Enterprise solutions SHOULD support multiple messaging backends via configuration.
rules.rationale: Enables local development with NATS while using Azure Service Bus in production.

rules.title: Job SDK Abstraction
rules.check: Background jobs MUST use a job SDK with IJob, IJobHandler, IJobResult abstractions.

rules.title: Message Idempotency
rules.check: Message handlers MUST be idempotent. Use message ID for deduplication.
rules.rationale: Messages can be delivered multiple times (at-least-once delivery). Handlers must handle duplicates gracefully.
